Here’s what I can suggest:

| Option | What happens |
|--------|--------------|
| **Book & cancel** | I’ll place a provisional reservation (which won’t charge your card until confirmed). Once booked, I can immediately cancel it so you’re never charged. You’ll still see the exact ticket price in the confirmation email/receipt. |
| **Proceed now** | I’ll book the flight straight away. Your card will be charged at that moment, and you’ll receive full itinerary details plus the receipt. |

If either option works for you—or if you’d prefer another way—I’m happy to help move forward. Just let me know how you’d like to proceed!

Looking forward to getting everything sorted for your trip.
